Name: Clean room for Shane - Marriage
Author: pandoraeremm
Description:
My first mod for Stardew Valley, I am sorry in advance for any possible bug or incompatbility missed.

[b][i][code]Incompatible with any other mod that changes the spouses room, even if not aimed to change Shane's.
[/code][/i][/b]

About this mod:
- A map edit to remove the spilled cans and clean the floor.
- Can walk  through the spots the old cans were.
- Removing the rug was an accident, but liked how it looked so left it at that.

Manifest.Name: Clean room for Shane - Marriage
Manifest.Description: Removes the spilled cans from your spouse's room and the stains from the floor.
Manifest.Author: eremm
